Three Features Tested

1. Compact Header Mode ✅ 100%

  • Responsive density controls (Min/Auto/Detail)
  • Headers: 125px → 48px (2.6× space savings)
  • Code: Lines 8-9, 3500-3512, 3596-3634

2. Advanced Filter Side Panel ✅ 100%

  • 360px collapsible drawer with live preview
  • Yellow row highlighting (rgba(254, 240, 138, 0.35))
  • Keyboard: Ctrl+Shift+F
  • Code: Lines 2826, 3250, 3836-3878, 3938+

3. Shift+Click Multi-Sort ✅ 100%

  • Numbered emoji badges: 1️⃣ ↑, 2️⃣ ↓, 3️⃣ ↑
  • Toolbar sort chain: “↕ USUBJID asc (1)”
  • Excel-style Shift+Click interaction
  • Code: Lines 2809, 2444-2469, 3440-3487, 3565-3577
